rules: rules/credit-rules.yaml (0.2; every rule this key cites is unchanged from the 0.1 draft)
scoring: A planted error counts as caught when the desk's log names at least one of its 'where' locations and reaches the 'correct_conclusion'. Report 'caught N of 14'. Decisions are scored separately against application_decisions, collections and order_decisions. Flagging a 'not_errors' item counts as a false positive.

planted_errors.title: Sunset Noodle Bar exists twice
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: C-1011 was opened by sales on 2026-09-28 for a business that is already C-1007. Same EIN (47-3318290 vs 473318290), same phone, same street address written differently.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Merge C-1011 into C-1007. Combined open balance is 14,270.00 against one 10,000.00 limit, so the customer is 4,270.00 over limit. Hold new orders (SO-5524) until the controller decides on the limit.
planted_errors.if_missed: The customer silently gets two 10,000 limits and keeps ordering past its real limit.

planted_errors.category: invoice total does not match lines
planted_errors.title: INV-24105 header overstated
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: Header total is 4,862.40; the nine lines add up to 4,286.40. The digits 862 and 286 are swapped.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: The customer owes 4,286.40. Correct or reissue the invoice (576.00 credit) before any reminder goes out.
planted_errors.if_missed: Collections chases 576.00 the customer does not owe.

planted_errors.title: PMT-8812 posted to INV-24089 instead of INV-24098
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: Golden Gate Bagel paid 1,940.00 with remittance INV-24098. The clerk keyed INV-24089 (digits transposed), which is Greenleaf Juice's 1,490.00 invoice. INV-24089 now shows a balance of -450.00 and INV-24098 shows as unpaid.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Reverse and reapply PMT-8812 to INV-24098 (Golden Gate, now paid). INV-24089 is open for 1,490.00 and 20 days past due; Greenleaf gets a second notice. Golden Gate gets no reminder.
planted_errors.if_missed: A paid customer gets dunned, and a customer who has not paid is treated as paid with a credit balance.

planted_errors.title: INV-24117 duplicates INV-24116
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: Same customer, date, PO FFTC-0930, lines and total (1,486.40). The order was billed twice.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Void INV-24117. Chase only INV-24116 (6 days past due: friendly reminder).
planted_errors.if_missed: The customer is billed and dunned for 1,486.40 twice.

planted_errors.title: PMT-8823 is a check dated 2026-11-06
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: Dogpatch Deli's check 4471 was received 2026-10-20 but is dated 2026-11-06. It was applied as cash and INV-24091 shows paid.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Not cash until 2026-11-06. INV-24091 stays open (2,036.75, 19 days past due). Hold the check and deposit it on or after 2026-11-06.
planted_errors.if_missed: The books show cash that does not exist, and the check may bounce if deposited early.

planted_errors.title: Rockridge Ramen took 2% after 24 days
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: Terms are 2/10 Net 30. INV-24095 is dated 2026-09-08; payment arrived 2026-10-02, 24 days later, still taking the 49.20 discount, and the clerk allowed it.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Disallow the discount. Reopen INV-24095 for 49.20 and send a short-pay notice.
planted_errors.if_missed: Fogline loses 49.20 here, and the customer learns that late discounts are accepted.

planted_errors.title: INV-24111 dated 2025 instead of 2026
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: INV-24111 shows invoice date 2025-09-29 and due date 2025-10-29, so it ages as 359 days past due. Its number sits between invoices from late September 2026, and its PO PPC-2247 follows PPC-2240 from 2026-09-22.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Correct the date to 2026-09-29 (due 2026-10-29). The invoice is not yet due. No final demand, and SO-5528 can ship.
planted_errors.if_missed: A good customer gets a final demand and a held order over an invoice that is not due.

planted_errors.title: Harborview's limit has not been reviewed since 2024-05-20
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: Policy requires a limit review every 12 months; Harborview's was due 2025-05-20, 17 months ago. It is 50 days past due on its oldest invoice with 27,655.75 open against a 30,000 limit.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Flag the overdue review to the credit analyst. No limit increase until reviewed. With the oldest invoice 50 days past due: phone call and hold new orders, including SO-5527 (which would also take exposure over the limit).
planted_errors.if_missed: A slow-paying customer keeps buying on a two-year-old limit.

planted_errors.category: over limit but not on hold
planted_errors.title: Telegraph Ave Pizza is over its limit with no hold
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: Open balance 18,240.60 against a 15,000.00 limit (3,240.60 over), oldest invoice 43 days past due, and on_credit_hold is still 'no'.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Place C-1005 on credit hold. Hold SO-5521. Phone call. Only the controller can release the hold.
planted_errors.if_missed: Another 2,400.00 ships to a customer already over its limit and 43 days late.

planted_errors.title: Pacific Crest Provisions LLC is a fake applicant
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: The numbers look clean and a simple rule approves 20,000. The identity checks fail. CRS: TransUnion identity FAIL (codes 2201 SSN not associated with the name, 2202 date of birth does not match the file, 2101 address does not match); Fraud Finder risk score 88 (email first seen 2026-10-15, six days before the application; phone is a prepaid VoIP line whose owner does not match; IP more than 1,000 miles from the address); the phone number has no owner on file (AccurateAppend); 9 credit inquiries between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-12. Case files: LLC filed 2026-09-01 but claims 4 years in business; bank account opened 2026-08-28; billing address is a private mailbox; ship-to is a freight forwarder in Florida; both trade references share one phone number; rush first order of 18,500 to ship tomorrow.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Fraud hold. No credit, no shipment on terms. Refer to the controller. Do not contact the applicant through the phone or email supplied. Cash in advance is the only offer.
planted_errors.if_missed: 18,500 of product ships to a forwarder and is never paid for.

planted_errors.title: Lakeshore Diner claims 1.85M; the bureau says 210K
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: Application states 1,850,000 revenue and 22 employees. The business credit file estimates 210,000 and 5 employees. Bank deposits average 17,600.00 a month (211,200.00 a year).
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Size the limit on the lower, verified figure (210,000): 10% is 21,000. Note the discrepancy in the decision. 21,000 is above the analyst's authority, so it goes to the controller.
planted_errors.if_missed: The limit is sized on revenue that does not exist (45,000 approved instead of 21,000).

planted_errors.title: Saffron Table says no liens; PitchPoint finds a lien and a judgment
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: The owner answered 'no' to open liens or judgments. CRS PitchPoint shows an unsatisfied 12,300 civil judgment (Lakeview Contractors, Cook County, filed 2023-03-15) and an unreleased 7,450 Illinois Department of Revenue tax lien (filed 2024-08-21) against her.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Treat as band C at best (Net 15, 7,500), note the false declaration, and send to the controller. Open terms with public records need controller approval.
planted_errors.if_missed: Credit is extended on a false declaration, and the tax lien may take priority over Fogline's claim.

planted_errors.title: Castellanos attached her own 18-month-old credit report
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: The attached TransUnion report (score 760) is dated 2025-04-02 and was supplied by the applicant.
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Ignore it. The desk pulls its own reports, valid for 30 days. Decide on the fresh pull.
planted_errors.if_missed: The applicant is banded A on an old, self-supplied score.

planted_errors.title: Castellanos: the three bureaus disagree
planted_errors.what_is_wrong: Fresh CRS pulls: TransUnion 760, Equifax no file, Experian 700 with one collection account (National Recovery, 640 past due).
planted_errors.correct_conclusion: Use the lowest score (700) and count the collection: band B (Net 30, at most 15,000). Requested 25,000 becomes 15,000, which is above the analyst's authority, so it goes to the controller.
planted_errors.if_missed: Banded A on the best bureau alone; 25,000 approved instead of 15,000.

desk.why: 770 at all three bureaus, identity PASS, Fraud Finder 9, no public records. Limit is the request (under 10% of verified revenue and band A's cap) and within the analyst's 10,000 authority.
Clean band A file (790), but 40,000 is above the analyst's 10,000 authority. The analyst proposes; the controller approves. This is the approval pause.
See E10. Any one of the fraud stop rules is enough; this applicant trips four.
Score 690 would be band B, but an open tax lien and an unpaid judgment drop it to band C and require the controller. The application denied both.
Ignore the applicant's 2025 report. Fresh pulls disagree; the lowest score (700) and the Experian collection put it in band B, capped at 15,000, which is above the analyst's authority.
815 and clean, but stated revenue is not supported. 10% of verified revenue (210,000) caps the limit at 21,000, which is above the analyst's authority.

collections.note: INV-24105 at its corrected 4,286.40 (E02), 1 day past due. INV-24111 is not due (E07).

order_decisions.why: Over limit and 43 days past due (E09).
C-1011 is C-1007; merged balance is over the limit (E01).
50 days past due, review overdue, and the order would take exposure to 30,755.75 over a 30,000 limit (E08).
Looks 359 days late only because of the wrong-year date (E07). Corrected, it is current.
Looks 11 days late only because PMT-8812 was misapplied (E03). Corrected, it is current.

not_errors.why_fine: 'Mission St. Taqueria' and 'MISSION ST TAQ INC' are how C-1003's name is printed and remitted. Same customer ID; not a duplicate.
Ships to 780 Valencia St, Golden Gate Bagel's second shop (noted in customers.csv). One customer, two ship-to addresses.
Bluebird's 2% discounts were taken 9 and 8 days after the invoice date, inside the 10-day window.
'Oakalnd' is a typo in the address, not a different customer or a fraud signal.
'Green Leaf Juice Co' is how C-1004's name prints on invoices.
A large request from a clean applicant is not an error. It needs the controller because of its size.
Rockridge paid INV-24074 in full on day 29 without taking a discount. On time.
